componentSet.defectConfirmed: Reproduced here before touching anything: verify-packet-completeness.mjs returned FAIL_COMPONENT_SET at 0/0 written, auditable:false, 'the field map uses a schema this verifier does not read; it is refused rather than read as empty'. readFieldRows() accepts four shapes and this family's production-field-map.json emitted none of them -- its documents carry writeBoxes, withheldBeforeTheFactory, roleRefusals, refusedByTheFactory and protectedRulesHandedToTheFactory -- so `shape` stayed null and the reader early-returned before counting anything.
componentSet.aSecondDefectIFoundWhileFixingTheFirst: The family's own disposition arrays covered only PART of its census. The petition census has 30 blanks and 20 carried a stated disposition; the order has 19 and 10 carried one. The remaining 19 were reachable only as anchor LABELS in refusedByTheFactory, which is not a per-blank disposition at all. Publishing the contract's schema over the old arrays alone would have published that gap; the emitter states every census blank exactly once instead.
componentSet.whatIChose: The first of the two repairs the verifier named -- emit this family's dispositions in documents[].fields[] with a decision word, which is one of the shapes the contract already reads and which the sibling ar-arrest-seal-set already emits. I did NOT extend readFieldRows(); that is a shared-contract change touching every family with this shape and is not this family's owned path.
componentSet.howItWasBuilt: A per-document `completeness` policy block keyed by blankId, mirroring ar-arrest-seal-set's, plus completenessFields() which walks census.blanks and emits one row per blank: decision 'write' where the canonical proof found ink at the measured rectangle, 'refuse' otherwise, carrying the policy's reason and either a closed-vocabulary refusalClass or requiredBeforeFiling:true. Every existing array is kept beside it unchanged so the two channels can be compared rather than trusted. Nothing new was decided: each disposition restates a refusal the family already made or a role the census already records.
twoIterationsTheContractForcedAndTheyWer: The name blank in 'Comes the Defendant/Petitioner, ____, under oath and states' was first declared participant_sworn_narrative_or_legal_election. The contract refused it -- that class may not excuse a PARTICIPANT_IDENTITY field -- and it was right. It is now signature_or_date_participant_completion, which is what it actually is: written in front of the notary in the same act as the signature beneath it.

Two of the three arrest-date components were declared required-before-filing but their printed captions were not quoted in participant-instructions.md, so the disclosure gate caught them as facts nobody asks the participant for. The instructions table now quotes both printed lines verbatim and explains why the year blank's caption reads like part of the charge sentence -- it starts the next printed line.
componentSet.result: FAIL_COMPONENT_SET 0/0 auditable:false -> PASS_COMPLETE 8/49 written, all nine counters zero. The family can now be audited at all, which is the point.

I disclosed both and named the clerk for the residual question rather than choosing silently.
arkansasObjectionWindow.whatIsAsked: Either a determination that the route-keyed manifest figure governs and the profile line does not address this pathway, or a counsel question about the felony limb.
